major_cooldowns.name: Combustion
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it as close to on cooldown as possible, starting it near the end of a hard cast so the cast lands inside the window, and stack trinkets and racials on top of it; with Firestarter hold the first one until the boss drops below 90% health, and delay it only for an imminent Time Warp or a burst mechanic.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Tooltip base cooldown is 120s; the guide states it is available every minute with Kindling talented, and the sampled top parse landed 10 Combustions on a roughly 60s cadence.

major_cooldowns.name: Meteor
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Make every Meteor land inside Combustion: precast it into the window, and with Burnout delay it to the last 8 seconds of Combustion, casting between 8 and 2 seconds remaining so the Ignite bank explodes as large as possible.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Base cooldown 45s; Blast Zone cuts it to 30s and then the guide sends it on cooldown, skipping a use if it slipped more than 10 seconds. Without Blast Zone it is used only inside Combustion, which is what the sampled top parse did (10 Meteors, 10 Combustions).

major_cooldowns.name: Time Warp
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Follow the raid or party leader's assigned timing; with no assignment, send it right off the pull so it overlaps everyone's cooldowns, but only when targets stay active for the full 40 seconds.

major_cooldowns.name: Blood Fury
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Fire it once Combustion is up with more than 6 seconds left in the window, or in the last 20 seconds of the fight.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Orc racial; only orcs will have casts of it.

rule.description: Spend Hot Streak on Pyroblast or Flamestrike
rule.action: Consume every Hot Streak: instant Pyroblast in single target, Flamestrike from 4 targets up. Outside Combustion, chain it behind a Fireball or Frostfire Bolt so both land together and fish for the next crit.

Time Meteor so it lands inside Combustion, either as the precast you cast Combustion into or with 8 to 2 seconds of the window left when running Burnout. With Blast Zone you also send it on cooldown outside the window, but skip that use if it slipped more than 10 seconds and save it for Combustion.

rule.description: Flamestrike over Pyroblast at high target counts
rule.action: Spend Hot Streak on Flamestrike from 4 targets up, inside and outside Combustion, with Fuel the Fire talented. Below 4 targets, and any time the boss is above 90% health under Firestarter, keep spending on Pyroblast. Only ever replace a Pyroblast, never a Fireball or Frostfire Bolt.

Press Fire Blast on Heating Up to convert it into a Hot Streak, weaving it into a hard cast so nothing is clipped. Spend ahead of the proc only to avoid sitting at capped charges, and keep converting inside Combustion and Hyperthermia since Hot Streak still doubles the Ignite.

Below 30% target health, Scorch becomes your Hot Streak builder in place of Fireball. Above 30% it is a movement filler only, and on a Frostfire build Frostfire Bolt stays the filler all the way down.
Hold Blood Fury for Combustion and fire it with more than 6 seconds of the window left, alongside your on-use trinkets. Dump it regardless in the last 20 seconds of the fight.
